description: **Status bar.** A persistent one-line bottom toolbar shows model, mode, context %, cumulative cost, working spinner, and queued-line count.
**Fix.** Banner prints immediately at launch instead of waiting for the first turn.
**Fix.** Harmless rate-limit lines no longer clutter the transcript.
**New feature.** Claude-Code-style boxed input with howmuchleft status lines replacing the old status bar.
**Breaking.** Removed the old status bar (build_status_line, spinner). Status information is now provided by howmuchleft.

**Fullscreen REPL.** Replaced inline PromptSession with a fullscreen Application: scrollable output, boxed input with Frame, howmuchleft status bar. Uses alternate screen (preserves scrollback) and 24-bit truecolor (lossless howmuchleft colors). Fixes dead-space gap, missing frame, and color quantization.
**Fix.** Table column alignment now accounts for emoji and wide character display width.
Input box now sizes to content instead of wasting 5 fixed lines
**Output scrollability.** The output window now auto-scrolls to show new content. Mouse scroll-up pauses auto-follow (scroll-lock); submitting input resumes it.
